checks.name: the board takes the clip pair for the capture
e4 takes d5 is accepted by the rules
at the hit the spear tip is at the defender flank (10–25 cm from the body axis)
the hit lands at body height (0.8–1.5 m)
after the hit the spear does not sink deeper into the defender (≥ hit − 2 cm from its trunk axis)
attacker moves without jumps (< 15 cm per frame)
bent knees point forward, never backwards
soles do not sink into the board (≥ rest − 2 cm)
pelvis over the feet while standing
planted feet do not slide (≤ 1.5 cm per frame)
no body or spear passes through a shield, own or opponent (bone chains, butt to tip)
the attacker looks at the defender (heading within 15°)
the defender looks at the attacker until the blow (heading within 15°)
after the scene the attacker stands on d5 and the victim is gone

scope: Sampled at 30 Hz with a fixed clock on the skinned pawns. Bodies come from the clip pair; arms, spear and shield from the loadout on the board timeline. Not a physics or continuous collision check.
